CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India Toronto, UNITED STATES 73259930 1073323". Counter vs rows seen: page header claims "Total Shipments 2988" (slug 1) and "1423" (slug 2), but only 5 detail rows are rendered per page in the free view — so 5 of 2988 and 5 of 1423 rows actually observed; the totals are site counters, not verified by me.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record obtained. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits could not be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, indiamart.com returned HTTP 429, and the web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. No domestic evidence line can be quoted; field left null rather than inferred.
note: Real export shipments confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: multiple consignments from Ahmedabad Air (INAMD4), Nhava Sheva Sea (INNSA1) and Chennai Sea (INMAA1) to the USA, UK, Italy, Austria and China, with named counterparties (Pentair Ashland, Armstrong Pumps, Varisco S.r.l., Flowserve Control Valves GmbH, Spirax-Sarco). Latest record seen 2026-02-27. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS in the batch is 848190 (parts of taps/valves), but every observed shipment line carries HS 73259930 — 'OTHER CAST ARTICLES OF STAINLESS STEEL MALLEABLE' (castings: impellers, shaft sleeves, guide cages, casings, adaptor frames). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 73259930, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed industry 'oil & gas and chemicals' is only partly supported — the observed buyers are pump/valve OEMs (Pentair, Armstrong, Flowserve, Spirax-Sarco, Varisco), i.e. flow-control castings, which is adjacent but not the same as oil & gas/chemicals end-use. Address in records: 1708/1709, GIDC Phase-II, Dolatpara, Gujarat. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources read, not estimated. Domestic (India) supply activity: no evidence found either way, so 'unknown', not 'none_found' — the absence is a tool-access failure, not a negative finding.
